Subject: Re: Difficult To Trace Errors :  "ERROR: [on_request_read]connectionreset by peer"

Hi Kousik,

I believe the source of the problem lies in this code. However, as of yesterday there were no problems at all in running this, and now it doesn't work even though no changes were made! I also covered this whole section of the code in browser() 's to see if I could figure out what was going on and got nowhere.

Code below is used to create a save/load interface for each user of the application so they can save their df's as csv to a server stored folder, where they can then pre-load into the application as-needed.

##CREATE USER FOLDER IF IT DOESNT EXIST AND SAVE RELEVANT INFORMATION TO THIS LOCATION
reactivePath <- reactive({
  if(nrow(authorization())>0){
    Base <- getwd()
    dir.create(file.path(Base, "Save Folder",input$usr), showWarnings = FALSE)
    User <-file.path(Base, "Save Folder",input$usr)
    return(list(Base=Base,User=User))
  }
  return(list(Base="",User=""))
})

##SAVE THE MAIN DATA FRAME TO A FILE WHEN ACTION BUTTON CLICKED
saveReactive <- reactive({
    isolate({ 
    saveNumber <- input$Save_Input
    })
    
    if(!(is.null(df))){
      if(!(is.null(saveNumber) || saveNumber == 0) & reactivePath()$User != ""){
        saveItem <- input$saveTxt_Input
        saveItem <- paste0(gsub("[[:punct:]]", "_",paste(saveNumber,saveItem,Sys.Date(),sep="_")),".csv")
        setwd(reactivePath()$User)
        write.csv(df,saveItem,row.names=FALSE)
        setwd(reactivePath()$Base)
        return("Saved!")
      }
  }
  return("")
})

##DISPLAY STATUS UPDATE IF SAVE WAS SUCCESFUL
output$saveStatus <- renderText({saveReactive()})

##Observe events to update load list
observe({
  if(saveReactive()!="" || reactivePath()$Base != ""){
        itemList <- c("",dir(reactivePath()$User))
        updateSelectInput(session,"loadSelect_Input",choices=itemList) 
  }
})

##Load data frame that user indicates------
userLoad <- reactive({
  isolate({loadNumber <- input$load_Input})
    
    if(loadNumber > 0 & input$loadSelect_Input != ""){
       return(read.csv(paste(file.path(reactivePath()$User),input$loadSelect_Input,sep="\\"),as.is=TRUE))
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  
})

From: Aaron Horowitz

To: shiny-...@googlegroups.com
Subject: Difficult To Trace Errors :  "ERROR: [on_request_read] connectionreset by peer"

Hey guys,

Am working on an app which worked fine yesterday, and now I'm getting disconnected from my sessions almost immeadeately!

The following is the error message I'm receiving:

Error in matrix(unlist(value, recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE), nrow = nr,  : 
  negative extents to matrix
ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer


Any ideas on where in my code I should be looking to debug this? In general, how do you go about debugging these particular problems?

Regards,
Aaron

parts:
Aaron, if you're running Shiny 0.8.0 or later, try running this before calling runApp():

options(shiny.error=recover)

Or, if you're using the latest version of RStudio, this is even better:

options(shiny.error=browser)
